templates.title: View transition grid
templates.summary: Coloured tiles shuffle and one expands to fill the panel, and every tile glides to its new slot. The browser does the tweening (View Transitions API, 0 KB).
templates.promptText:
Animate DOM reordering and expansion with the View Transitions API (no library).
- Give every tile a unique view-transition-name (el.style.viewTransitionName = `tile-${i}`).
- Wrap each DOM change in document.startViewTransition(update): shuffle = re-append children in a new order; expand = add .expanded (grid-column/row 1 / -1) to one tile and hide the others; collapse = remove it.
- CSS: ::view-transition-group(*) { animation-duration: .7s; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) }, ::view-transition-old/new(*) { height: 100% } so text doesn't stretch, ::view-transition-old/new(root) { animation: none }, ::view-transition { pointer-events: none }.
- Catch vt.ready and vt.finished (skipped transitions reject). Skip transitions while the page is scrolling.
- No support or reduced motion: call update() directly; the layout still changes instantly.
Start from templates/view-transition-grid/index.html.

zh.title: View Transitions 网格
zh.summary: 彩色方块打乱重排，其中一块放大铺满面板，每一块都平滑滑到新位置。补间由浏览器完成（View Transitions API，0 KB）。
zh.effect: 网格里的五个彩色方块先打乱两次位置，然后其中一块放大铺满整个面板（显示说明文字）再缩回；每一块都平滑地移动到新位置。不用动画库：浏览器对 DOM 快照做变形。
zh.use: 排序和筛选结果、卡片展开成详情、仪表盘重新排列。任何能描述成“之前 / 之后”的 DOM 变化都适用。
knobs: 所有变形的时长和缓动
只有命名的元素会变形；没命名的随根元素交叉淡入淡出
pits: 捕获快照时如果有两个元素的 view-transition-name 相同，过渡会被中止。
`hidden` 会被你自己写的 `display` 规则覆盖；被“隐藏”的副本仍可能占用同一个名字。
快照是图片：放大的方块里文字会被拉伸，除非给 old/new 设置 `height: 100%`。

templates.title: Conic ring
templates.summary: A rainbow ring spins around a morphing blob with zero JavaScript: @property makes a gradient angle animatable, and border-radius keyframes do the morph.
templates.promptText:
Make a spinning conic ring around a morphing blob in pure CSS.
- Register @property --a { syntax: "<angle>"; inherits: false; initial-value: 0deg } so the angle interpolates; @keyframes spin-a { to { --a: 360deg } }.
- Ring: a circle with background conic-gradient(from var(--a), lime, cyan, violet, coral, lime), masked to a 5px band with mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent calc(100% - 6px), #000 calc(100% - 5px)). Animate spin-a 2.6s linear infinite.
- Glow: the same gradient, blur(22px), opacity .55, masked to the outer band.
- Blob: 62% size, its own conic gradient with spin-a reversed (9s), plus a 7s morph keyframe over border-radius (e.g. 42% 58% 70% 30% / 45% 45% 55% 55% → 70% 30% 46% 54% / …) with small rotate/scale.
- Reduced motion: animation none (it still looks finished).
Start from templates/conic-ring/index.html.

zh.title: 锥形渐变光环
zh.summary: 彩虹光环绕着一团变形的色块旋转，完全不用 JavaScript：@property 让渐变角度可以动画，border-radius 关键帧负责变形。
zh.effect: 一圈细细的彩虹光环（青柠 → 青 → 紫 → 珊瑚）绕着柔光旋转，环内的渐变色块在几种有机形状之间缓慢变形并反向旋转。纯 CSS。
zh.use: AI 助手头像、加载和“思考中”状态、状态光球、精选卡片的动态边框。
knobs: 配色
光环粗细
旋转、变形和反转的速度
pits: 没有 `@property` 时，`--a` 只是字符串，渐变会跳变而不是旋转。
渐变动画每帧都会重绘；一个光球没问题，不要大面积使用。

templates.title: Drag parallax track
templates.summary: Drag a horizontal row of images; the row glides with inertia while each image pans the opposite way inside its frame.
templates.promptText:
Build a full-screen draggable image track with inner parallax using the Web Animations API (no library).
- A fixed, overflow-hidden stage. The track is absolutely positioned at left: 50%, top: 50%, display: flex, gap 4vmin.
- Track position is a percent from 0 (first image at centre) to -100 (last image at centre): transform translate(P%, -50%).
- Images are 40vmin × 56vmin, object-fit: cover; object-position runs from 100% to 0% as P goes 0 → -100 (object-position: `${100 + P}% center`). That opposite pan is the parallax.
- Every input calls render(P): el.animate({ transform }, { duration: 1200, fill: "forwards", easing: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) }) on the track and the same for objectPosition on each image. Retargeting a new animation each move gives the glide for free.
- Pointer drag: dragging half the window width = 100%. Use setPointerCapture. Also wheel (preventDefault, non-passive) and ArrowLeft/Right that step one image.
- Reduced motion: duration 0.
Start from templates/drag-parallax-track/index.html.

zh.title: 拖拽视差画廊
zh.summary: 拖动一排图片，整排带着惯性滑动，每张图片在自己的框里反向平移。
zh.effect: 一排竖长的图片横跨屏幕中部。拖动（或滚轮、方向键）时整排以长长的缓出滑动，每张图片的内容在框内反向平移，看起来比页面更有纵深。
zh.use: 作品集、图库、案例展示条。全屏、6–12 张图片效果最好。
knobs: 滑动的重量感：600ms 轻快，1800ms 沉重
拖动灵敏度
竖图最能体现平移；横图会减弱效果
pits: 要裁切舞台（`position: fixed; overflow: hidden`），否则轨道会把页面撑宽，手机上会横向滚动。
图片要加 `-webkit-user-drag: none` 和 `draggable=false`，否则浏览器会开始原生的图片拖拽。
`touch-action: pan-y` 让手机上竖向滚动照常工作，横向拖动交给轨道。

templates.title: Glow cards
templates.summary: A light follows the pointer across a card grid, lighting every card's 1px border and the hovered card's surface.
templates.promptText:
Build a grid of feature cards with a pointer-following glow, using CSS custom properties and a few lines of vanilla JS (no library).
- Each card is a 1px "border" layer (the card background) with an inner panel inset by 1px.
- One pointermove listener on the grid writes --mx/--my (pointer position relative to each card) on every card, throttled to one rAF; read all getBoundingClientRect() first, then write.
- card::after: radial-gradient(420px circle at var(--mx) var(--my), accent 60% alpha, transparent 40%) under the panel, visible while the grid is hovered, so all borders near the pointer light up.
- card::before: radial-gradient(640px circle ..., accent 8% alpha) over the panel, visible only on the hovered card.
- Fade both with a 400ms opacity transition. Start --mx/--my off-screen so nothing glows on load.
- Touch (hover: none): replace the effect with a static gradient border.
Start from templates/glow-cards/index.html.

zh.title: 光晕卡片
zh.summary: 一束光跟着指针扫过卡片网格，照亮每张卡片 1px 的边框，以及当前悬停卡片的表面。
zh.effect: 一束柔光跟随指针扫过卡片网格。靠近指针的每张卡片的 1px 边框都会亮起，指针下方的卡片表面还会泛起淡淡的光。
zh.use: 功能网格、Bento 布局、价格表。每页用一处，这是“高级 SaaS”的标志性效果。
knobs: 灯光颜色（`r g b`）
边框光 / 表面光的半径
边框 / 表面的亮度
间隙越宽，光在卡片之间跳变得越少
pits: 边框光必须放在内层面板**下面**（`z-index` 1 对 2）；放在上面会把整张卡片照满。
不要给每张卡片单独绑监听：光要在指针进入卡片之前就照到它的边框。
写样式之后再调用 `getBoundingClientRect()` 会强制布局。先统一读，再统一写。

templates.title: Infinite marquee
templates.summary: Rows of logos or tags scroll forever in opposite directions, fading at the edges and pausing on hover.
templates.promptText:
Build an infinite horizontal marquee with CSS animation, as a progressive enhancement.
- Base markup is a normal <ul> that wraps (flex-wrap) and is readable with no JS and under reduced motion.
- JS (skipped under prefers-reduced-motion) sets data-animated, copies the items (aria-hidden="true") until one set is at least as wide as the row, then duplicates the whole list once more so it is two identical halves.
- Animated state: overflow hidden; mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 12%, #000 88%, transparent); ul is nowrap, width: max-content, animation: marquee var(--speed) linear infinite; @keyframes marquee { to { translate: calc(-50% - var(--gap) / 2) } }.
- data-direction="right" uses animation-direction: reverse. :hover pauses with animation-play-state.
Start from templates/infinite-marquee/index.html.

zh.title: 无限跑马灯
zh.summary: 几行 Logo 或标签朝相反方向无限滚动，两端渐隐，悬停时暂停。
zh.effect: 一行或多行胶囊标签（Logo、标签、引言）不停地横向滑动，相邻两行方向相反。两端用遮罩渐隐，悬停某一行时它会暂停。
zh.use: “谁在用我们”Logo 墙、技术栈条、用户评价滚动条。
knobs: 每圈的秒数。保持慢速：Logo 用 30–60 秒
项目间距；关键帧也用到它，所以只在一处修改
边缘渐隐的宽度
pits: 正好移动 `-50%` 会在循环点跳动半个间距，要再减去 `var(--gap) / 2`。
一组内容比一行还窄时，循环前会露出空隙。把这组重复到填满一行。
副本要对读屏软件隐藏（`aria-hidden`），否则每个 Logo 会被读两遍。
给 body 加 `overflow-x: clip`，防止手机上横向滚动。

templates.title: Jelly button
templates.summary: Buttons squash flat on press and wobble back on release, driven by a real damped spring with three tunings.
templates.promptText:
Make press-and-release "jelly" buttons with the Web Animations API and a tiny spring solver (no library).
- pointerdown / Space / Enter: animate scale to `${1+s} ${1-s}` (s = 0.10–0.16) in 110ms, ease-out, fill forwards.
- pointerup / pointerleave / keyup: read the current scale from getComputedStyle (it reflects the running animation; "none" means 1), cancel the press animation, then simulate a damped spring from that deformation d0 to 0 (x'' = -k·x - c·v, dt 1/60, stop when |x| and |v| are tiny). Play the samples as keyframes { scale: `${1+d} ${1-d}` } with easing linear and duration = samples × 16.7ms.
- Tunings: soft k 180 c 9, balanced k 320 c 16, firm k 520 c 26.
- Reduced motion: skip both animations; the button still works.
Start from templates/jelly-button/index.html.

zh.title: 果冻按钮
zh.summary: 按下时按钮被压扁，松开后像果冻一样回弹，由真实的阻尼弹簧驱动，提供三档手感。
zh.effect: 按下按钮时，它在约 110ms 内被压扁（变宽变矮）。松开后像果冻一样晃回原状。晃动来自真实的阻尼弹簧，所以长按比轻点晃得更厉害；三档调校分别是柔软、均衡和紧实。
zh.use: 主要 CTA、点赞 / 收藏按钮、活泼的消费级产品界面。专业工具用紧实那一档。
knobs: 越大，晃得越快
越大，晃的次数越少。临界阻尼是 2√k：达到或超过它就不会过冲
按压时的形变量。超过 0.2 看起来像坏了
pits: 用两个值（x y）、方向相反地缩放 `scale`，让按钮保持“体积”。两个方向一起缩小看起来是缩小，不是压扁。
松开时的弹簧要从**当前**缩放值开始，而不是完全压扁的状态，否则轻点一下会先跳到完全压扁再晃。
`pointerleave` 也要触发松开，否则拖出按钮后它会一直保持压扁。
什么时候用弹簧、什么时候用固定时长，见 spec/motion.md。

templates.title: Motion curves
templates.summary: A living easing reference: the same ball travels the same distance nine ways (linear, ease out/in/in-out, hard stop, overshoot, anticipation, spring, bounce), with physics-to-linear() helpers.
useFor: copying spring / bounce curves into CSS
templates.promptText:
Pick the motion curve from spec/motion.md section 1 by what the object is doing (entering, leaving, moving A→B, hitting a wall, popping in, winding up, following a gesture, landing).
To use a spring or bounce in CSS or WAAPI without a library, copy springToLinear(k, c, m) / bounceToLinear() from templates/motion-curves/index.html:
- springToLinear simulates a damped spring from 0 to 1 (dt 1/120) until it settles, samples ~60 points and returns { easing: "linear(...)", duration }. Use that duration with the easing.
- bounceToLinear samples the classic three-bounce ease-out into linear().
For a "hard stop", use cubic-bezier(0.55, 0, 1, 0.45) and then a 160ms squash (scale 0.8 1.15 with transform-origin on the impact side) so the stop reads as an impact.

zh.title: 运动曲线对照
zh.summary: 一份会动的缓动参考：同一个球用九种方式走同样的距离（匀速、缓出 / 缓入 / 缓入缓出、急停、过冲、预备、弹簧、弹跳），附带把物理曲线转成 linear() 的工具函数。
zh.effect: 九条跑道，每条一个球，同时出发、距离相同：匀速、缓出、缓入、缓入缓出、急停（带撞击形变）、过冲、预备动作、弹簧和弹跳。放在一起看，曲线之间的差别一目了然。点击某条跑道可以单独重播。
zh.use: 挑选缓动、给设计师展示选项、把弹簧或弹跳曲线复制成纯 CSS。什么场景用哪种曲线，见 [spec/motion.md](../../spec/motion.md)。
useFor: 把弹簧 / 弹跳曲线复制到 CSS
knobs: 见 spec/motion.md 第 3 节的弹簧预设表
非物理跑道共用的时长
加上你产品自己的曲线来对比
pits: 弹簧的时长由它的物理参数决定。用 `linear()` 把慢弹簧硬塞进 300ms，会截掉回稳过程，最后突然跳到终点。
y 值超出 0–1 的 `cubic-bezier`（过冲、预备）会越过起点或终点：要留出空间，否则会被 `overflow: hidden` 裁掉。
`linear()` 需要 Chrome 113+、Safari 17.2+、Firefox 112+。旧浏览器会退回 `linear`，动画仍会停在正确位置。

templates.title: Scroll drum picker
templates.summary: A plain scrolling list becomes a 3D drum: each item tilts away, shrinks and dims as it leaves the centre band, driven by CSS view() timelines with no scroll listeners.
templates.promptText:
Turn a scrolling list into a 3D drum with CSS scroll-driven animations.
- The scroller: overflow-y auto, perspective 420px, scroll-snap-type y proximity, items scroll-snap-align center, padding-block = half the scroller height so the ends can reach the centre.
- Inside @supports (animation-timeline: view()): .item { animation: drum linear both; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: cover 0% cover 100% } with keyframes 0% rotateX(68deg) scale(.8) opacity 0 → 44–56% rotateX(0) scale(1.06) opacity 1 lime → 100% rotateX(-68deg) scale(.8) opacity 0.
- Progress bar: scroll-timeline: --drum block on the scroller, timeline-scope: --drum on a common ancestor, bar animation: grow linear both; animation-timeline: --drum.
- Draw a fixed centre band over it (pointer-events none). Without support the list just scrolls. Reduced motion: animation none.
Start from templates/scroll-drum-picker/index.html.

zh.title: 滚动 3D 滚轮
zh.summary: 普通的滚动列表变成 3D 滚轮：每一项离开中间区域时会后仰、缩小、变暗，由 CSS view() 时间线驱动，不用滚动监听。
zh.effect: 面板里的竖向列表在滚动，看起来像一个 3D 滚轮：中间那一项最大、高亮，上下的项向后倾斜（rotateX ±68°）、缩小并淡出。顶部的进度条跟随滚动。没有滚动监听：这是 CSS 滚动驱动动画。
zh.use: 日期 / 时间或选项选择器、功能列表、随滚动联动的菜单。
knobs: 每一项向后倾斜的角度
“焦点”平台的宽度
越小，3D 感越强
pits: `animation-timeline` 必须写在 `animation` 简写之后，简写会把它重置。
命名时间线要在滚动容器的子树之外使用，需要在共同祖先上设置 `timeline-scope`。
`view()` 跟踪的是最近的滚动容器：中间夹着 `overflow: hidden` 的包装层会让它失效。

templates.title: Shape morph UI
templates.summary: One shape never cuts: it springs between a button, loader, check, dynamic island, player, toggle, command bar and toast on a 120 BPM beat.

source.author: @twoclipping (concept), nexu-io/open-design (template)
source.license: Concept only; open-design is Apache-2.0, no code copied

templates.promptText:
Build a "one shape" UI morph with CSS transitions and a linear() spring (no library).
- One element (.shape) with overflow hidden whose width, height, border-radius and background come from CSS variables --w --h --r --c. Transition width/height/border-radius over 620ms with
  --spring: linear(0, 0.13 3%, 0.5 9%, 0.86 16%, 1.04 23%, 1.08 28%, 1.06 34%, 1 44%, 0.99 53%, 1); color over 240ms ease.
- Inside, one .face per state, absolutely centred and laid out at its final size so text never reflows. Inactive faces: opacity 0, scale .92, blur 4px. The active face (matched by data-state on the shape) fades in with a 180ms delay so the shape leads.
- A STATES array holds { id, w, h, r, c, beats }. A timer advances at 120 BPM (500ms per beat). Click / Enter advances manually. Provide a Pause button and stop the timer when the tab is hidden.
- Reduced motion: no autoplay, transitions 0ms, stop inner loops.
Start from templates/shape-morph-ui/index.html.

zh.title: 单图形形变 UI
zh.summary: 同一个形状从不切换：它在按钮、加载、对勾、灵动岛、播放器、开关、命令栏和通知之间弹性变形，踩着 120 BPM 的节拍。
zh.effect: 屏幕上始终只有一个圆角形状，它从一个 UI 组件弹性变成下一个：生成按钮 → 加载 → 对勾 → 灵动岛 → 音乐播放器 → 开关 → ⌘K 命令栏 → 通知 → 回到按钮。每次变化都落在 120 BPM 的节拍上；形状先动，内容晚 180ms 淡入。
zh.use: 产品首屏的循环动画，或任何真实的状态链，比如 提交 → 加载 → 完成 → 通知。
useFor: 状态变化（提交 → 加载 → 完成）
knobs: 故事线。每个状态的尺寸差别要足够大，变形才看得出来
变形的弹性和速度；其他弹簧曲线见 spec/motion.md
节奏。内容多的状态（播放器、命令栏）停 3 拍
形状和内容之间的间隔；120–220ms 能体现“形状先行”
pits: 这里动画的是 `width`/`height`（布局属性），**单个**独立元素可以接受。多个元素请改用 `clip-path: inset(... round r)` 或 FLIP 缩放。
内容层不能跟着形状改变尺寸，否则变形时文字会换行跳动。给它们固定宽度。
超过 5 秒的循环需要暂停控件（WCAG 2.2.2）。

templates.title: SVG spinners
templates.summary: Sixteen loading indicators (rings, dots, bars, blocks, gooey balls), each a tiny self-contained SVG animated with SMIL. Colored by currentColor; click to copy.
templates.promptText:
Use one spinner from templates/svg-spinners/index.html (MIT, Shubham Jain's SVG Spinners): copy the <svg> markup inline.
- Size it with width/height (they use viewBox 0 0 24 24); color it with the CSS color property, since fills are currentColor.
- Inside a button, put it before the label at 1em, set aria-busy="true" on the button and keep the label text for screen readers.
- SMIL ignores prefers-reduced-motion: call svg.pauseAnimations() when reduced motion is on.
- If you inline several on one page, check that their id attributes (used by SMIL begin="x.end") stay unique.

zh.title: SVG 加载动画
zh.summary: 16 种加载指示器（圆环、圆点、竖条、方块、黏连小球），每个都是自带 SMIL 动画的小 SVG，颜色跟随 currentColor，点击即可复制。
zh.effect: 16 种加载指示器：旋转圆环、弹跳和缩放的圆点、黏连融合的小球、脉冲圆环、波浪竖条、交换位置的方块。每个都是一个不到 4KB 的 `<svg>`，用 SMIL 自己动起来，不需要 CSS 或 JS。
zh.use: 加载中的按钮、行内“加载中…”文字、空状态、AI“思考中”指示。
knobs: 加载动画的颜色
尺寸；任何大小都保持清晰
该动画的速度
pits: 有些动画用 id 串联（`begin="spinner_X.end"`）。同一页放两个相同的动画会共用 id，第二个可能卡住。给每个副本改 id，或者用 ``（图片里的 id 互不干扰，但不能用 `currentColor`）。
除非手动暂停，SMIL 在减弱动态效果和后台标签页里仍会继续运行。
等待超过约 300ms 再显示加载动画。很快就返回的请求闪一下加载动画，反而显得更慢。

templates.title: Text scramble
templates.summary: Letters churn through random glyphs and lock into the real word from left to right, on load or hover.
templates.promptText: Add a text scramble effect in vanilla JS (no library) to every element with [data-scramble]. - Store the real text in data-text and set aria-label to it. - On trigger (load and/or pointerenter + focus), give each letter a lock time: (i / (n-1)) * SPREAD * DURATION + (1 - SPREAD) * DURATION * random(). DURATION 900ms, SPREAD 0.6. - In a rAF loop, but only swap glyphs every ~45ms, render letters that have not locked as random char from "A–Z 0–9 #%&*+=<>/", spaces stay spaces. When time passes DURATION, set textContent back to the real text. - Cancel the previous rAF on re-trigger so hovering repeatedly restarts cleanly. - Use a monospace font so the width does not jump. - Reduced motion: do nothing. Start from templates/text-scramble/index.html.

zh.title: 乱码解密文字
zh.summary: 字母在随机字符间快速跳动，然后从左到右逐个锁定成真正的单词，在加载或悬停时触发。
zh.effect: 一个单词被“解密”：每个字母先在随机字符间闪烁（以强调色高亮），然后大致从左到右逐个锁定，全程约 0.9 秒。
zh.use: 首屏标题、导航链接，以及科技、安全或开发者品牌的标签。短词（≤ 20 个字母）效果最好。
knobs: 到最后一个字母锁定的总时长
1 = 严格从左到右的波浪，0 = 所有字母随机锁定
字符集：片假名、二进制 `01` 或制表符会改变气质
越小，闪烁越急促
pits: 比例字体会让每次替换时行宽抖动。用等宽字体，或用 `display:inline-block; width:1ch` 固定每个字母的宽度。
在 120Hz 下每帧都换字符是噪音，不是动效。限制在每秒 20–25 次。
把用户输入的文字放进 `innerHTML` 有注入风险：不是你自己的文字要先转义。

templates.title: Motion path timeline
templates.summary: A comet travels a curved path through five steps; DrawSVG paints the trail behind it and each node pops as it arrives. One looping GSAP timeline.
templates.promptText:
Animate a step-by-step process diagram with GSAP 3.15.1 MotionPathPlugin + DrawSVGPlugin (both free; registerPlugin).
- Build one smooth SVG path through the step positions (Catmull-Rom → cubic Bézier). Draw it twice: a dashed base and a gradient "glow" copy starting at drawSVG "0% 0%".
- Measure each node's fraction along the path (sample getPointAtLength) so the comet stops exactly on it.
- One timeline, repeat -1: for each segment, tween the comet with motionPath { path, align, alignOrigin [0.5,0.5], start: frac[i-1], end: frac[i] } (0.85s power2.inOut) and the glow to drawSVG "0% frac[i]%" at the same time; then pop the node: r 7→9 back.out(3), fill lime, plus a ring r 8→34 fading out.
- At the end: comet scales up and fades, glow wipes to "100% 100%", nodes reset with a 0.06 stagger.
- Pause the timeline off-screen. Reduced motion: no timeline, show the full trail and all nodes lit.
Start from templates/motion-path-timeline/index.html.

zh.title: 路径动画时间线
zh.summary: 彗星沿曲线经过五个步骤；DrawSVG 在它身后画出轨迹，每个节点在彗星到达时弹出。一条循环的 GSAP 时间线。
zh.effect: 一条虚线曲线连接五个带标签的步骤。发光的彗星沿曲线逐个经过；身后画出渐变轨迹，每个节点在彗星到达时弹出（变大、变亮、扩散出一圈光环）。然后轨迹擦除，循环重新开始。
zh.use: “如何运作”和流程介绍区块、新手引导步骤、路线图。
useFor: 流程 / 运作方式区块
knobs: 步骤位置和标签（viewBox 单位）
步骤之间的移动速度
节点弹出的力度
pits: motionPath 里的 `start`/`end` 是整条路径的比例，不是分段序号。要实际测量，否则彗星会停在两个节点之间。
对带虚线的路径用 DrawSVG 会画虚线本身；虚线底线和发光轨迹要分成两条路径。

templates.title: Split-flap words
templates.summary: Words flip in letter by letter like a departure board (3D rotateX per character), hold, flip away, and the next word follows, with a progress scrubber.
templates.promptText:
Make rotating split-flap words with GSAP 3.15.1 SplitText (registerPlugin; wait for document.fonts.ready).
- Stack the words absolutely in one line box; each word wrapper gets perspective: 420px, its chars transform-style preserve-3d and backface-visibility hidden.
- SplitText.create(word, { type: "chars" }); set chars to rotationX -100, yPercent 30, opacity 0, transformOrigin "50% 50% -24px" (pivot behind the letter = flap).
- One timeline (repeat -1): per word, chars to rotationX 0 / yPercent 0 / opacity 1 (1s expo.out, stagger 0.04), hold 1s, then to rotationX 100 / yPercent -30 / opacity 0 (0.5s power2.in, stagger 0.025). Overlap words by 0.15s.
- Optional: drive a progress bar from tl.progress() in onUpdate.
- Reduced motion: show the first word, no loop.
Start from templates/split-flap-words/index.html.

zh.title: 翻牌字
zh.summary: 单词像机场翻牌一样逐个字母翻出来（每个字符做 3D rotateX），停留，再翻走，下一个单词接上，并有进度条。
zh.effect: 一个大号斜体单词逐个字母拼出来，每个字母像机场翻牌一样从后方翻下。停留片刻后向上翻走，下一个单词翻入。底部的说明和进度条跟随循环。
zh.use: 首屏轮换关键词（“Build. Ship. Scale.”）、功能标语、状态看板。
knobs: 转轴越靠后，翻牌幅度越大
字母之间的延迟
每个单词停留的时长
pits: transformOrigin 没有 z 偏移时，rotateX 只会把字母压扁；转轴在字母后方才有翻牌效果。
要在字体加载完成后再拆分，否则字母宽度是按备用字体测量的。

templates.title: Scroll layout flip
templates.summary: Galleries pin to the screen and morph into a new layout as you scroll: a row whose centre frame fills the screen, a grid that folds into a fanned deck, a bento that blows up past the edges.
templates.promptText:
Build scroll-scrubbed layout changes with GSAP 3.15.1 Flip + ScrollTrigger (CDN: gsap.min.js, Flip.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js; gsap.registerPlugin(Flip, ScrollTrigger)).
- Each gallery sits in a 100svh wrapper. Its start layout is plain CSS; its end layout is the same markup with an .is-final class (different grid, sizes, margins).
- For each gallery: add .is-final, Flip.getState(tiles + caption, { props: "filter, opacity" }), remove .is-final, then
  Flip.to(state, { ease: "none", simple: true, scale: true, scrollTrigger: { trigger: gallery, start: "center center", end: "+=300%", pin: wrapper, scrub: true } }).
- Per-gallery options: absoluteOnLeave + scale:false for the row whose centre tile goes full-screen; stagger 0.05 with power2.inOut for the stack.
- Wrap it in gsap.matchMedia: with reduced motion, add .is-final to every gallery and do no pinning.
- Flip measures pixels: on a width change, revert the gsap.context, restore the original style attributes, rebuild, ScrollTrigger.refresh().
Start from templates/scroll-layout-flip/index.html.

zh.title: 滚动布局重组
zh.summary: 画廊固定在屏幕上，随滚动变成新的布局：中间那张放大铺满屏幕的一排、收拢成扇形卡组的网格、放大到超出屏幕的 Bento。
zh.effect: 滚动时每个画廊固定在屏幕上，方块随滚动条从一种 CSS 布局滑到另一种。三个示例：中间一张放大铺满屏幕的一排图、收拢成扇形卡组的网格，以及放大到超出屏幕边缘的 Bento 网格。
zh.use: 作品集、产品叙事、案例研究、编辑类页面。每页两三个，中间隔着正常内容。
knobs: 画廊固定期间的滚动距离；越长，变形越慢
目标布局。任何 grid、flex 或尺寸变化都行
`none` 与滚动条 1:1 同步；`power2.inOut` 加 stagger 让方块逐个离开
一起补间的额外 CSS 属性（filter、opacity、borderRadius）
pits: 先记录**最终**状态，再移除类名。Flip.to 是从当前画面动画到记录的状态。
固定的是**外层包装**，不是画廊本身：Flip 移动的是画廊的子元素，固定占位不能放在被测量的布局里。
撤销 Flip 后终值会留在内联样式里；窗口尺寸变化重建前要先重置 `style` 属性。
忽略手机上只有高度变化的 resize（地址栏伸缩），否则滚动时页面会不停重建。

templates.title: Split text reveal
templates.summary: Three text reveals in one file: headline lines rising out of masks, letters fading up from a blur in random order, and a paragraph that lights up word by word as you scroll.
templates.promptText:
Add text reveals with GSAP 3.15.1 SplitText + ScrollTrigger (CDN dist/*.min.js, registerPlugin).
- Always split with SplitText.create(el, { ..., autoSplit: true, onSplit(self) { return tween } }) so lines re-split on resize and the tween is rebuilt. Wait for document.fonts.ready first.
- Lines: type "lines", mask "lines"; gsap.from(self.lines, { yPercent: 110, duration: 1.1, ease: "power4.out", stagger: 0.12 }).
- Letters: type "words, chars" (words keep letters from breaking mid-word); from { opacity 0, filter blur(12px), yPercent 30 }, 0.9s power3.out, stagger { each: 0.03, from: "random" }, scrollTrigger { start: "top 80%", once: true }.
- Read-along: type "words"; fromTo opacity 0.18 → 1, ease none, stagger 0.1, scrollTrigger { start: "top 75%", end: "bottom 45%", scrub: true }.
- Hide [data-reveal] with visibility:hidden only when JS runs (.js class on <html>), show after splitting. Use gsap.matchMedia: under reduced motion, don't split, just show.
Start from templates/split-text-reveal/index.html.

zh.title: 文字揭示
zh.summary: 一个文件里三种文字揭示：标题逐行从遮罩中升起、字母从模糊中随机浮现、段落随滚动逐词点亮。
zh.effect: 三种揭示。（1）大标题逐行出现，每一行从自己的遮罩里滑上来。（2）标题进入屏幕时，字母按随机顺序从模糊中浮现。（3）段落一开始是暗的，随滚动条逐词点亮。
zh.use: 首屏标题（1）、区块标题（2）、宣言或“关于我们”段落（3）。每个元素只用一种，每页不超过两种。
knobs: “从槽里升起”的感觉；最少 100 才能从隐藏开始
可以试试 `"start"`、`"center"`、`"edges"`
点亮整段需要滚动多少距离
pits: 字体加载前就拆分，会在错误的位置断行。等待 `document.fonts.ready`，并用 `autoSplit`，窗口变化时会重新拆分。
只拆成字母会让单词在行尾从中间断开；要拆成 `"words, chars"`。
给几百个字母加 `filter: blur()` 很耗性能。模糊揭示只用于标题。
读屏：SplitText 会给父元素加 `aria-label` 并隐藏拆开的碎片，不要去掉它。

templates.title: Spring goo trail
templates.summary: Seven blobs chase the pointer on springs, each following where the head was a moment ago; an SVG goo filter melts them into one stretchy creature.
templates.promptText:
Build a gooey spring trail with Motion 14.9.0 (const { animate } = await import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/motion@14.9.0/+esm")).
- Seven absolutely positioned circles (54px down to 14px, lime → cyan) in a container with filter: url(#goo), where #goo is feGaussianBlur stdDeviation 9 → feColorMatrix alpha row "0 0 0 22 -10" → feComposite atop SourceGraphic.
- Keep a history of head positions (pointer, or a Lissajous path when idle). 20 times a second, push the head into history and call animate(blob, { x, y }, { type: "spring", stiffness: 260, damping: 18, mass: 0.9 + i·0.08 }) with blob i chasing history[i·2].
- Retargeting a running Motion spring preserves its velocity; that's what makes the chain swing instead of snapping.
- Pause the loop off-screen. Reduced motion: blobs rest in the centre.
Start from templates/spring-goo-trail/index.html.

zh.title: 弹簧黏液拖尾
zh.summary: 七个圆球用弹簧追着指针，每一个都追向头部片刻前的位置；SVG 黏液滤镜把它们融成一个能伸缩的小生物。
zh.effect: 一串从青柠到青色、逐渐变小的七个圆球追着指针（空闲时走 8 字形）。每个圆球用弹簧追向头部片刻前的位置，所以整串会滞后、拉伸、摆动；SVG 黏液滤镜把重叠的圆球融成一团液体。
zh.use: 趣味光标、首屏吉祥物、可交互的空状态。
knobs: 尾巴越重，滞后越多
黏液阈值：越大，融合边缘越锐利
pits: 以固定频率重新设定目标（这里是每秒 20 次），不要每次 pointermove 都设：每秒几百个新弹簧是浪费。
黏液滤镜作用于透明度，所以圆球需要实色填充；滤镜层里的文字也会被融化。

templates.title: Stagger ripple grid
templates.summary: An 11×11 grid of tiles ripples outward from wherever the pointer touches: each tile lifts, spins and flashes colour with a delay set by its grid distance.
templates.promptText:
Build a ripple grid with Anime.js v4.5.0 (const { animate, stagger, utils } = await import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/animejs@4.5.0/+esm")).
- An N×N CSS grid (N = 11) of <i> tiles.
- ripple(from): one animate(dots, {...}) call with keyframe arrays: translateY to -26·amp², scale to 0.55 + 1.1·amp², rotate to 90·amp (220ms outQuad), then back to 0 / 1 / 0 (950ms "outElastic(1, .4)"); backgroundColor to an accent then back. amp = 1 − distance-from-source / diagonal, as a function value (el, i) => ….
- delay: stagger(60, { grid: [N, N], from }) makes it a wave from that tile.
- pointerover on the grid: ripple from the hovered tile (throttle to 180ms). Idle: ripple from utils.random() every 1.7s while on screen.
- Reduced motion: no ripples.
Start from templates/stagger-ripple-grid/index.html.

zh.title: 交错涟漪网格
zh.summary: 11×11 的方块网格从指针触碰的位置向外泛起涟漪：每个方块按网格距离延迟，依次跳起、旋转、闪色。
zh.effect: 一个由小圆角方块组成的正方形网格。涟漪从一个方块向外扩散：每个方块跳起、变大、旋转并闪一下强调色，然后带着弹性晃动落回原位。离源头越近，动得越大。悬停时从指针下方泛起涟漪；空闲时从随机方块泛起。
zh.use: 可交互的首屏背景、空状态、活泼的加载或“思考中”状态。
knobs: 波速：每格的毫秒数
回落时的晃动（幅度、周期）
网格尺寸；超过约 20×20 改用 canvas
pits: Anime.js v4 没有默认导出，也没有 `targets` 参数：写法是 `animate(targets, params)`；缓动是 `outElastic`，不是 `easeOutElastic`。
给指针触发的涟漪加节流：121 个方块每次 pointerover 都触发会堵塞主线程。

templates.title: Iridescent blob
templates.summary: A 40k-vertex sphere boils with simplex noise on the GPU, painted with a fresnel iridescence, orbited by two rings and a star field; the pointer steers it.
templates.promptText:
Render an iridescent noise blob with Three.js 0.187.0 (import map "three" → jsDelivr build/three.module.js).
- IcosahedronGeometry(1, 64) with a ShaderMaterial. Vertex shader: 3D simplex noise (Ashima snoise) displaces each vertex along its normal, disp = snoise(n·uFreq + uTime·0.35)·uAmp; recompute the normal from two nearby displaced points so lighting follows the lumps.
- Fragment shader: fresnel = pow(1 − dot(n, v), 2); colour = 0.5 + 0.5·cos(2π(vec3(0, .33, .67) + fresnel·0.85 + disp·1.8 + uTime·0.05)) (cosine palette), plus diffuse, a sharp specular and a lime rim pow(fresnel, 5).
- Add two thin TorusGeometry rings (violet, cyan, opacity .55) and 900 additive Points as stars.
- Pointer sets a target; ease toward it (×0.05/frame) and use it for rotation and uAmp (0.22 + 0.1·distance).
- renderer.setAnimationLoop(frame) while visible, setAnimationLoop(null) off-screen. DPR ≤ 2. Reduced motion: render one frame.
Start from templates/iridescent-blob/index.html.

zh.title: 幻彩球体
zh.summary: 4 万个顶点的球体在 GPU 上用 simplex 噪声翻涌，表面是菲涅尔幻彩，两道光环和星空环绕；指针可以操控它。
zh.effect: 一个光滑的球体，表面缓缓翻涌成柔和的起伏，随视角在紫、青、青柠之间流转（幻彩），边缘有一圈青柠色轮廓光。两道细细的彩色光环绕着它，背后是稀疏的星空。移动指针会让它倾斜、旋转，表面翻涌得更厉害。
zh.use: 首屏主视觉、AI 和科技品牌的高光时刻、加载页。每页一个，它很吃 GPU。
knobs: 起伏的高度和大小
余弦调色板的相位：改变颜色循环
精细度；手机上 32 就够
pits: 只移动顶点不重新计算法线，凹凸的形状上会是光滑球体的光照。
用 `renderer.setAnimationLoop`，并在离开屏幕时停止；隐藏的 WebGL 循环照样消耗 GPU。

templates.title: Dot globe
templates.summary: A slowly rotating dotted WebGL globe with glowing markers, arcs between cities and labels that fade when they turn behind it. Drag to spin.
templates.promptText:
Add a rotating dotted globe with COBE 2.0.1 (import createGlobe from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cobe@2.0.1/+esm").
- Square canvas sized by CSS; pass width/height = CSS size × devicePixelRatio (capped at 2).
- Options: dark 1, diffuse 1.2, mapSamples 16000, mapBrightness 5, theta 0.28, colors as 0–1 RGB arrays, markers [{ id, location: [lat, lng], size }], arcs [{ from, to }], arcColor, arcWidth 0.6, arcHeight 0.28.
- COBE 2 has NO onRender option. Run your own requestAnimationFrame loop and call globe.update({ phi, width, height }). Auto-rotate phi by 0.0035/frame; pointer drag adds to phi and leaves a decaying velocity (×0.95 per frame).
- Labels: for a marker with id "sf", position a label with position-anchor: --cobe-sf; bottom: anchor(top); left: anchor(center); and opacity: var(--cobe-visible-sf, 0) so it hides behind the globe. Hide labels where anchor positioning is unsupported.
- Fade the canvas in after the first frame. Pause the loop off-screen (IntersectionObserver) and when the tab is hidden. Reduced motion: no auto-rotation, drag still works.
Start from templates/dot-globe/index.html.

zh.title: 点阵地球
zh.summary: 缓慢旋转的点阵 WebGL 地球，带发光标记、城市间的弧线，以及转到背面时会淡出的标签。可拖动旋转。
zh.effect: 一个点阵地球缓缓转动。城市标记以强调色发光，弧线把它们连起来，每个城市的标签转到地球背面时会淡出并模糊。拖动时带惯性甩动。
zh.use: 全球化产品（CDN、支付、物流）的首屏，“服务 90 个国家的客户”之类的区块。
useFor: 全球网络 / CDN / 支付页面
knobs: 配色，0 到 1 的 `[r, g, b]`
陆地点的亮度和密度
朝观者的倾斜；0.2–0.35 能看到北半球
空闲时的旋转速度
pits: COBE 的 README 和很多教程仍在用 `onRender(state)`。2.x 里它会被静默忽略，地球不会转。用 `globe.update()`。
忘了乘设备像素比，地球会模糊；在 3 倍屏手机上不加上限，填充开销会很大。
组件卸载时调用 `globe.destroy()`。

templates.title: Fluid cursor
templates.summary: The pointer stirs glowing ink through a real-time fluid simulation that swirls, curls and fades over the page. Click for a burst.
templates.promptText:
Add a pointer-driven fluid simulation over the page with WebGL 2, based on Pavel Dobryakov's WebGL Fluid Simulation (MIT, keep the notice).
- Fixed full-screen canvas, pointer-events none, alpha true. Requires EXT_color_buffer_float (render to RGBA16F/RG16F/R16F); if missing, or under reduced motion, don't start.
- Double-buffered half-float framebuffers: velocity (RG, 128 short side), dye (RGBA, 1024), pressure (R), plus divergence and curl (R).
- Each frame (dt ≤ 1/60): curl → vorticity confinement (CURL 28) → divergence → pressure ×0.8 → 20 Jacobi pressure iterations → subtract pressure gradient → advect velocity (dissipation 0.25) → advect dye (dissipation 1.2).
- pointermove: one splat at the pointer with velocity = pointer delta × 6000 (aspect-corrected) and a colour from a slow hue cycle at low brightness (~0.16). pointerdown: six random splats.
- Display pass: normal-based shading (×0.7–1.0), linear → gamma, alpha = max(r, g, b), blend ONE / ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA, so empty areas are see-through.
- Seed 5 splats at start so the first frame isn't empty.
Start from templates/fluid-cursor/index.html.

zh.title: 流体光标
zh.summary: 指针在实时流体模拟里搅动发光的墨水，墨水在页面上打旋、卷曲、渐渐消散。点击会炸开一团。
zh.effect: 移动指针会推动彩色墨水穿过真实的流体：它卷成漩涡、自我折叠、慢慢消散。点击会落下一团。没有墨水的地方画布是透明的，能透出页面。
zh.use: 创意和设计公司网站的首屏背景、404 页面、可交互的启动画面。很吃 GPU：每页一个，不要放在长文阅读的背后。
useFor: 创意 / 设计公司网站
knobs: 旋涡程度。0 = 平滑的烟，40+ = 湍流
拖尾持续多久。0.5 长，3 短
笔刷大小和推力
色相范围；亮度保持在 0.2 以内，否则重叠的墨水会变成白色
画质与 GPU 开销。手机上降到 64 / 512
pits: WebGL 2 只有在支持 `EXT_color_buffer_float` 时才能渲染到浮点纹理。没有它，帧缓冲不完整，屏幕一直是黑的。
每写一次双缓冲后都要交换读写缓冲，否则下一步会读到自己的输出。
尺寸变化时重建帧缓冲会清空墨水；可以接受，但要防抖。
它每帧都在运行。离开屏幕时暂停；rAF 在隐藏的标签页里本来就会暂停。

templates.title: Ink seam transition
templates.summary: As the next section scrolls up, the edge between a dark hero and a light page bleeds like ink into wet paper: ragged lobes, thin runs, darker rims, wider when you scroll fast.
templates.promptText:
Add an "ink bleed" seam between a dark hero and a light section, with a WebGL 2 fragment shader on a strip that straddles the hero's bottom edge (no library).
- The strip is an empty, pointer-events:none, absolutely positioned box from (hero bottom − 28vh) to (hero bottom + 30vh), with a canvas filling it (DPR capped at 1.5). One full-screen triangle, the shader gets px coordinates with y down.
- Uniforms: uSize, uEdge (= the 28vh above), uTravel (innerHeight − hero.bottom), uProgress (travel / innerHeight, clamped 0–1), uVelocity (scroll speed px/s, smoothed ×0.3 per frame, 0 under 2), uPaper and uHero (the page and the hero's bottom colour, read from CSS variables).
- Ink field g = (fbm-warped lobes − 0.42)·2.8 + (fine fray − 0.5)·0.35 + pow(fbm runs, 3)·0.9, drifting with uTravel. Reach = down·tanh(g·spread·0.9) below, −up·tanh(−g·spread·0.5) above, spread = smoothstep(0, 0.35, progress) + min(|v|/3000, 0.35). Feather the edge by 0.8 + |v|·0.004 px.
- Paint only the difference from the page under it: paper colour where it cuts up into the hero, hero colour (×(1 − 0.45·rim) for the darker rim) where it runs into the paper, transparent elsewhere. Premultiplied alpha.
- The hero background must be exactly uHero at its bottom (solid for the last ~45%) or a line shows at the edge.
- Draw in a rAF loop only when the strip is on screen and travel/velocity changed. Reduced motion or no WebGL 2: skip it, the plain edge remains.
Start from templates/seam-transition/index.html.

zh.title: 墨水交界转场
zh.summary: 下一个区块向上滚动时，深色首屏和浅色页面之间的交界像墨水渗进湿纸：参差的墨团、细细的纤维、更深的边缘，滚得越快晕得越开。
zh.effect: 深色首屏和下方浅色区块之间的直线边界，随滚动活了起来：首屏的颜色以参差的墨团和细纤维渗进纸面，纸面又在墨团之间反向侵入首屏，墨水在边缘积得更深。滚得快晕得更开，往回滚会收回来。
zh.use: 工作室、编辑类或品牌网站的首屏与内容交界处。每页一处。
knobs: 墨水最远能渗多远；两侧都要避开文字
墨团大小；数值越小墨团越大
细竖纤维的明显程度
边缘积墨的深浅
pits: 如果首屏边缘的颜色和 `uHero` 不完全一致，会出现一条 1px 的接缝。让首屏底部为纯色，或者像 Codrops 原版那样采样纹理。
没有移动时不要每帧重绘：先比较滚动距离和速度。
平滑滚动库是用 transform 移动内容的：从库里读取位置，不要读 `scrollY`。

templates.title: Flow field hero
templates.summary: 2,600 particles stream through a drifting noise field in four colours, leaving additive light trails; the pointer (or an idle ghost cursor) stirs a vortex into them.
templates.promptText:
Build a flow-field particle hero on a 2D canvas (no library).
- Canvas sized to the hero × DPR (≤ 2). Particle count = min(2600, area / 420); each has x, y, life, colour index and speed.
- field(x, y) = sum of three sines/cosines of x, y and time → an angle; velocity = (cos a, sin a)·speed·1.5.
- Vortex: within radius R = 0.32·min(W, H) of the (eased) pointer, add a tangential push (−dy, dx)/d·f·5 plus a little outward push, f = (1 − d/R)². When idle, the pointer target follows a slow Lissajous path.
- Each frame: fill rgba(bg, 0.085) with source-over (fades old trails), switch to "lighter", build one Path2D per colour with moveTo/lineTo for every particle's step, stroke each path once. Respawn particles that age out or leave.
- Pause the loop off-screen. Reduced motion: run 90 steps once for a still frame.
Start from templates/flow-field-hero/index.html.

zh.title: 流场首屏
zh.summary: 2600 个粒子在缓慢漂移的噪声场里流动，四种颜色，留下叠加发光的拖尾；指针（或空闲时的幽灵光标）在其中搅出漩涡。
zh.effect: 成千上万条细细的彩色笔触（青柠、紫、青、珊瑚）像地图上的风一样流过首屏，在缓慢变化的场里打旋。重叠处会发光。指针，或空闲时一个看不见的游走光标，会搅出漩涡，让附近的粒子绕着它转。
zh.use: 首屏背景、落地页、大字号背后的生成式品牌艺术。
knobs: 拖尾长度（保持 ≥ 0.06，否则会留下 8 位残影）
气流的尺度和漂移
漩涡的大小、旋转和推力
pits: 每个粒子 `stroke()` 一次就是约 2600 次绘制调用；按颜色合并成一个 Path2D。
设置画布宽高会清空画布；尺寸变化时要重绘背景。
透明度低于约 0.06 的淡出在 8 位色深下永远擦不干净，会留下灰色残影。

templates.title: Donut transition
templates.summary: A donut chart re-flows to new data every two seconds: arcs tween angle by angle with attrTween, and the centre percentage counts with textTween.
templates.promptText:
Animate a donut chart between datasets with D3 7.9.2.
- d3.pie().sort(null) (keep slice order stable) and d3.arc().innerRadius(60).outerRadius(84).cornerRadius(5).padAngle(0.035) in a viewBox "-100 -100 200 200".
- Store each path's current angles on the node (this._cur). On update: paths.data(pie(newData)).transition().duration(1100).ease(d3.easeExpOut).attrTween("d", function (d) { const i = d3.interpolate(this._cur, d); this._cur = i(1); return (t) => arc(i(t)); }).
- Centre label: .transition().textTween(() => { const i = d3.interpolateRound(old, pct); return (t) => i(t) + "%" }).
- Start from zero-angle arcs so the first draw sweeps in. Stop the interval off-screen. Reduced motion: draw the final arcs directly.
Start from templates/donut-transition/index.html.

zh.title: 环形图过渡
zh.summary: 环形图每两秒切换到新数据：扇区用 attrTween 按角度补间，中心百分比用 textTween 计数。
zh.effect: 一个有五块圆角、带间隙扇区的环形图，外圈刻度环缓缓转动。每两秒数据变化一次：扇区扫到新的角度（不是直线变形），中间的大号百分比数字计数到新值。
zh.use: 仪表盘、实时 KPI、报告页。任何数字会在用户眼前变化的图表。
knobs: 扫动的速度和手感
扇区之间的间隙和圆角
pits: 直接过渡 `d` 会对路径字符串插值，扇区会从圆心折过去。要用 attrTween 对角度插值。
要用 `pie().sort(null)`，否则数值变化时扇区顺序会变，满图乱飞。

templates.title: Lottie like button
templates.summary: A multi-layer After-Effects-style like animation (heart press, fill pop, trim-path rays, flying dots), with frame-exact scrubbing and like / unlike segments from one file.
templates.promptText:
Play an After Effects (Lottie) icon animation with lottie-web 5.13.0 (lottie_light.min.js, SVG renderer) and control it from code.
- lottie.loadAnimation({ container, renderer: "svg", loop: false, autoplay: false, animationData }) (or path: "like.json" for a designer's file).
- One file holds both transitions: frames 0–40 = like, 40–60 = unlike. On click toggle aria-pressed and call anim.playSegments(liked ? [0, 40] : [40, 60], true).
- Scrubbing: a range input 0–59 calls anim.goToAndStop(frame, true); keep it in sync on "enterFrame" with anim.currentFrame.
- Wrap the player in a real <button aria-pressed> so it's keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible.
- Reduced motion: goToAndStop on the final liked frame instead of playing.
Start from templates/lottie-like-button/index.html (its buildHeart() shows the JSON structure: shape layers, trim paths, keyframed scale/opacity).

zh.title: Lottie 点赞按钮
zh.summary: 一个多图层的 After Effects 风格点赞动画（按下、心形弹出、修剪路径射线、飞散圆点），可精确到帧拖动，同一个文件里分出点赞 / 取消两段。
zh.effect: 一个心形图标：按下时灰色描边被压扁，然后珊瑚色的心形弹出、超过原大小再回稳，八道射线射出又自行擦除（修剪路径），小圆点向外飞散并淡出。取消点赞时心形缩回成描边。帧进度条说明你可以停在时间线的任意一帧。
zh.use: 点赞、收藏和书签按钮，成功状态，以及设计师在 After Effects 里做的任何图标动画。
useFor: 点赞 / 收藏 / 书签按钮
knobs: 必须和设计师标记的帧对应
图标用 "svg"，大而复杂的场景用 "canvas"
不用重新导出就能加速
pits: `lottie_light` 不支持表达式；设计师用了表达式的话，加载完整的 `lottie.min.js`。
`playSegments(seg, true)` 立即跳转；传 `false` 会排在当前片段之后。
Lottie 把最后一个图层画在最底下：JSON 里的图层顺序是从上到下。
调用 `playSegments` 之后，`goToAndStop(frame)` 是从片段起点算的。拖动完整时间线前先调用 `setSegment(0, totalFrames)`。
lottie-web 加载时会就地改写路径数据；不要在图层或动画之间共用同一个路径对象。

templates.title: Flubber morph
templates.summary: One SVG path morphs circle → star → six dots (split) → heart (merge) → squircle and back, with matching gradient shifts. Flubber handles shapes with different point counts.
templates.promptText:
Morph between unrelated SVG shapes with Flubber 0.4.2 (global flubber).
- Describe shapes as point rings ([[x, y], …]); multi-part shapes as arrays of rings.
- Build interpolators once: flubber.interpolate(a, b, { maxSegmentLength: 2 }) for one → one, flubber.separate(one, many, { single: true }) to split, flubber.combine(many, one, { single: true }) to merge (single: true returns one path string with several subpaths).
- In a rAF loop, set path d = interpolator(ease(t)) with an ease-in-out quint, 1s per morph + 0.55s hold; switch gradient stop colours (CSS transition on stop-color) at each step.
- Stop the loop off-screen. Reduced motion: show one shape.
Start from templates/flubber-morph/index.html.

zh.title: Flubber 形变
zh.summary: 一个 SVG 路径依次变形：圆 → 星 → 六个圆点（拆分）→ 心形（合并）→ 圆角方形，再回到圆，渐变色随之变化。Flubber 能处理顶点数不同的形状。
zh.effect: 一个渐变形状不停变化：圆 → 五角星 → 拆成六个圆点 → 圆点合成心形 → 圆角方形 → 圆，每次变形约 1 秒，短暂停留，渐变颜色随形状变换。
zh.use: 图标状态切换、Logo 出场、趣味插画，任何一个形状变成另一个形状的场景。
knobs: 越小，变形越平滑，点越多
变形和停留的时长
pits: 插值函数在循环外创建一次：创建它很贵，调用它很便宜。
一变多时不加 `single: true` 会得到一组路径，每一块都需要一个 <path>。

templates.title: Vertex blobs
templates.summary: Three translucent blobs wobble vertex by vertex, orbit each other and blend with screen mode, while satellites circle a dashed orbit. The pointer pulls them apart.
templates.promptText:
Draw wobbling vertex blobs with Two.js 0.8.24 (global Two).
- new Two({ type: Two.Types.svg, fitted: true, autostart: false }).appendTo(host). Put everything in a group centred and scaled to the stage on each update.
- Three makeCircle(0, 0, 52, 30) blobs (30 vertices each); keep a clone of the rest vertices. Every update, scale each vertex: rest × (1 + 0.09·sin(t·2.2 + i·0.7 + phase) + 0.06·sin(t·1.3 + i·0.25 + 2·phase)), and move the blob on a small orbit plus an eased pointer offset.
- Set mix-blend-mode: screen on each blob's renderer element (b.renderer.elem) after the first two.update().
- Add a dashed orbit circle and four satellites. two.play() while visible, two.pause() off-screen. Reduced motion: one still update.
Start from templates/vertex-blobs/index.html.

zh.title: 顶点色块
zh.summary: 三个半透明色块逐顶点蠕动，彼此环绕，用滤色模式叠加，小卫星沿虚线轨道运行。指针会把它们拉开。
zh.effect: 三个柔和的色块（青柠、紫、青）沿松散的轨道漂移，轮廓有机地蠕动，重叠处颜色叠加（滤色）。小卫星沿缓慢转动的虚线圆环运行。指针会把色块不同程度地拉离中心。
zh.use: 生成式首屏艺术、品牌氛围背景、语音或音频可视化。
knobs: 越多，轮廓越平滑
蠕动强度
色块很多时切到 canvas 或 webgl
pits: `renderer.elem` 在第一次渲染之后才存在：设置样式前先调用 `two.update()`。
用 SVG 渲染器每帧修改顶点会重写路径字符串；超过约 50 个色块改用 `Two.Types.webgl`。

templates.title: Canvas editor
templates.summary: A mini design canvas: drag shapes, click to get rotate / resize handles, magnetic centre guides, and elastic snapping to a dot grid. Konva's Transformer does the heavy lifting.
templates.promptText:
Build an interactive canvas editor with Konva 10.9.1 (global Konva).
- Stage sized to the container (ResizeObserver → stage.size()), a non-listening background layer with a dot grid (24px), and a main layer with draggable shapes (Rect with offset at its centre, Circle, Star, Text).
- Selection: one Konva.Transformer (keepRatio, rotationSnaps every 45°, styled anchors). stage.on("pointerdown"): select e.target, or clear when the stage itself is clicked. Move the selected node and the transformer to the top.
- dragmove: if within 10px of the stage centre, snap to it and show a dashed guide line. dragend: hide guides and new Konva.Tween({ node, x: snap(x), y: snap(y), duration: 0.45, easing: Konva.Easings.ElasticEaseOut }).play().
- Hover: scale ×1.04 with node.to({ duration: 0.15 }).
- Optional idle demo: every 1.6s select a shape and tween its position / rotation / scale with onUpdate: () => tr.forceUpdate(). Stop it on the first user input and when off-screen.
Start from templates/canvas-editor/index.html.

zh.title: 画布编辑器
zh.summary: 一个迷你设计画布：拖动图形，点击出现旋转 / 缩放手柄，居中参考线带吸附，松手后弹性吸附到点阵网格。重活由 Konva 的 Transformer 完成。
zh.effect: 一块带点阵网格的画布上有四个对象（青柠圆角卡片、紫色圆、珊瑚色星星、斜体文字）。点击某个对象，会出现虚线框和旋转、缩放手柄；拖动时出现会吸附的青色居中参考线；松手后对象弹性吸附到网格。空闲时它会自己演示：对象被选中后滑动、旋转、缩放。
zh.use: 编辑器、白板、产品配置器、贴纸和拼贴工具、座位或平面图规划。
knobs: 吸附步长
旋转手柄会吸附的角度
回落的手感；不要回弹用 `StrongEaseOut`
pits: 补间修改了选中的节点时，要调用 `transformer.forceUpdate()`，否则手柄会跟不上。
Transformer 缩放改的是 scale，不是宽度：保存尺寸时要读 `scaleX()`。
把网格放在 `listening: false` 的图层上，避免它抢走点击。

templates.title: Particle fireworks
templates.summary: A sparkling trail follows the pointer and fireworks burst every second, with gravity, colour fades and light trails from additive blending over a fading canvas.
templates.promptText:
Build pointer trails and fireworks with Proton 7.1.5 (classic <script> build/proton.min.js; the class is window.Proton.default, the named classes are on window.Proton).
- Canvas sized to the container × DPR. new P.default(); a CanvasRenderer whose onProtonUpdate paints rgba(8,9,12,0.24) over the canvas (source-over) and then sets globalCompositeOperation "lighter", so particles leave trails and glow where they overlap.
- Trail emitter: Rate(Span(2, 4), 0.02), Radius, Life(0.6, 1.4), Velocity(Span(0.3, 1.2), Span(0, 360), "polar"), Alpha(1, 0), Scale(1, 0.2), Color([lime, cyan, white]); ease its position toward the pointer every frame.
- burst(x, y): a new Emitter with Rate(Span(70, 110), 0), Velocity(Span(1.6, 4.2), Span(0, 360), "polar"), Gravity(1.6), Alpha, Scale, Color(from, [to…]); emit("once", true) so it destroys itself. Burst on pointerdown and every 1.1s.
- Call proton.update() in your rAF loop (Proton has no loop of its own); stop it off-screen. Reduced motion: one frozen burst.
Start from templates/particle-fireworks/index.html.

zh.title: 粒子烟花
zh.summary: 闪烁的拖尾跟着指针，每秒炸开一朵烟花，带重力、颜色渐变，以及在渐隐画布上叠加发光形成的光痕。
zh.effect: 一片夜空。青柠和青色的闪烁拖尾跟着指针（或自己游走），每秒炸开一朵烟花：70–110 颗火花呈圆形飞出，受重力下落、缩小并淡出，因为每帧只擦除上一帧的一部分，所以会留下光痕。

templates.title: GIF export
templates.summary: A seamless canvas loop drawn from t (not the clock), encoded to a GIF in the browser with gifenc in a few dozen milliseconds, ready to save.
templates.promptText: Encode a canvas animation to a GIF in the browser with gifenc 1.0.3 (import { GIFEncoder, quantize, applyPalette } from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gifenc@1.0.3/dist/gifenc.esm.js"). - Write draw(ctx, t, size) as a pure function of t ∈ [0, 1): every angle and size uses t·2π, so frame N equals frame 0 and the loop is seamless. - Live preview: a rAF loop advancing t by dt / period. - Export: an offscreen canvas (getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true })), N = 40 frames; for each, draw(ctx, i / N), getImageData, quantize(data, 128) once for a shared palette, applyPalette, gif.writeFrame(index, S, S, { palette, delay: 50 }). gif.finish(); new Blob([gif.bytes()], { type: "image/gif" }) → object URL for an and a download link. - Reduced motion: show frame 0 as a still PNG instead of the GIF. Start from templates/gif-export/index.html.

zh.title: GIF 导出
zh.summary: 一段由 t 驱动（而非时钟）的无缝画布循环，用 gifenc 在浏览器里几十毫秒内编码成 GIF，可直接保存。
zh.effect: 两个并排的方块：左边是实时画布，四段彩色圆弧绕着一个跳动的圆点旋转；右边是刚在浏览器里编码好的同一段循环 GIF，附带帧数、文件大小、编码耗时和保存链接。
zh.use: README 和社交媒体预览、可分享的贴纸、设计评审用的循环动画。MP4 / WebM 和 Playwright 录制见 rules/export.md。
knobs: 帧数和每帧毫秒数（循环长度 = N × delay）
调色板大小：颜色越少，文件越小
输出尺寸（像素）
pits: 按真实时钟绘制会让最后一帧和第一帧对不上：GIF 在循环点会卡顿。
所有帧共用一个量化调色板（或小心地逐帧处理）；逐帧调色板会闪烁。
重新编码时要释放旧的 object URL。
